identity.fantasy: A Frost-and-Nature storm caster who builds Conductive stacks through Brine and surrounds targets with orbs, spheres, clouds, and elementals before cashing out.
identity.one_line: A Frost-and-Nature storm caster who builds Conductive stacks through Brine and surrounds targets with orbs, spheres, clouds, and elementals before cashing out. The defining decision is contextual: Movement and target lifespan determine whether to build, channel, or spend.

mechanics.core_loop: A Frost/Nature caster that builds Conductive stacks with Brine and cashes them out through Torrential Wrath and Conduction. Thunder Orbs, Power Spheres, elementals, Drown, and Stormcloud add layered target setup. It has burst and battlefield activity, but more object and stack tracking than Lightning.

modes.name: Tempest Sovereign
modes.structural_description: Enhances some of your spells with the power of the maelstrom, transforming your Shock into Brine and Call Lightning into Torrential Wrath.BrineGenerates 25 StaticDouse an enemy, dealing cond(gt(SPFR, SPN), 89+0+SPFR*0.571, 89+0+SPN*0.871) Frost damage, scaling with your critical strike rating.Scales with modifiers to Shock.Torrential WrathDepletes 50 StaticBlast an enemy, dealing cond(gt(SPFR, SPN), 111+0+SPFR*1, 111+0+SPN*1.5) Frost damage, scaling with your haste rating.

modes.name: Spheres of Power
modes.structural_description: Your direct damage dealt now has a 25% chance to summon a Power Sphere that will move towards your target. Can only have 1 Power Sphere up at a time.Power Sphere will redirect its movement towards enemies you cast Stormflow on.Upon reaching the target, it deals cond(gt(SPA, SPN), 697+33+SPA*0.485, 697+33+SPN*0.485) Spellstorm Damage to them and enemies within 5 yds.

mechanics.single_target: Build Conductive with Brine, position Thunder Orbs and Stormcloud, then cash stacks through Torrential Wrath and Conduction. Players report strong boss damage, but no source gives a verified full sequence.
mechanics.aoe: Layered objects and weather effects offer pack coverage, yet current players call Maelstrom's AoE weaker than its boss damage and worry about channeling in PvP.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Ranged positioning is flexible, but placed objects and target setup make movement planning important.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Its structural defensive package includes Blessing of Lei Shen, Drown, Lethal Current, Thunder Ward, Spheres of Power.
mechanics.group_utility: Group or control tools include Prodigy of Lei Shen, Mystic Thunder, Conductor In Charge.

failure_modes.text: Consuming Conductive too early, leaving orbs or clouds behind, or losing a channel wastes several layers of target setup.
Placing Thunder Orbs or Stormcloud where the target will not remain strands damage and setup resources.
Beginning an exposed channel without control or positioning support gives opponents a simple way to cancel the payoff.
